title: Every position taken
notes: k = 7 items on 7 positions: every position gets one, so the answer is the smallest gap between neighbours, 13 − 12 = 1, the bottom of the range. Binary search tries 12, 6, 3 and 2, which all fail: 4 checks and 28 reads. Trying upward fails at 2 on its first check, with 7 reads.
